subject: Kickoff: depth from unknown cameras (video-in-the-wild)
body:
Alina, team,

Kicking off the video-in-the-wild depth track. The differentiator here is unknown cameras: because the model can learn intrinsics rather than requiring them, we can train on and serve depth for arbitrary user-uploaded video -- YouTube-style footage, dashcams, old phone clips. That is the unlock for the media-tools depth feature, where we control nothing about the capture device.

Mechanics per the ICCV release: training takes triplets of RGB frames with possibly-moving objects masked out, and produces 6-DoF camera motion plus a dense translation vector field.

Milestones: masking + data pipeline live May 22, baseline quality review June 15, intrinsics ablation and LRB readout the first week of July.

Alina owns staffing; note we share people with other vision tracks, so let's be explicit about allocations.

Lucia
